name: session
description: FR-BB35 -- ports exam_sessions from c:\Users\tvolo\dev\ai-dala\BilimBaga\backend\migrations\014_exam_sessions.up.sql, with status widened by 015_session_tables.up.sql's ALTER TYPE. Product spec: corporate_exam_platform_roadmap.md section 3.6. FIELD-LEVEL NOTES. exam_id is :string, queried: true, required: true, with foreign_keys entry fk_session_exam_id making it a real Postgres REFERENCES against the exam entity type. user_id is :string, queried: true, required: true, but carries NO fk_def: users live in the identity subsystem, and references_entity names an entity type in the tenant's own entity subsystem, not an identity-subsystem table -- the same reasoning REQ-326 recorded for created_by. status is :enum with FOUR values in_progress, submitted, auto_submitted, grading_pending; the source's 014 migration declares only the first three, and grading_pending was added afterward by 015's `ALTER TYPE session_status ADD VALUE IF NOT EXISTS 'grading_pending'` -- the fourth value is not in 014, it is a 015 addition. seed is :integer (source BIGINT), queried: false, required: true; its purpose is reproducibility of the shuffled question set derived at session creation, per roadmap 3.5, not a value ever filtered on. started_at is :datetime, queried: false, required: true. expires_at is :datetime, queried: true, required: true -- it MUST be queried: true because REQ-331's auto-submit sweep locates expired sessions by scanning on this field, standing in for the source's partial index idx_exam_sessions_expires_status; a definition where expires_at is not queried would leave that sweep with no indexed predicate to run against. submitted_at is :datetime, queried: false, required: false (source nullable, set only on submission). score_pct is :decimal with decimal_precision 5 and decimal_scale 2, ported verbatim from the source's DECIMAL(5,2), queried: false, required: false. passed is :boolean, queried: false, required: true (source NOT NULL DEFAULT FALSE). Foreign keys: fk_session_exam_id (field exam_id, references_entity exam). Indexes: idx_session_exam_user over (exam_id, user_id) and idx_session_user_exam_status over (user_id, exam_id, status), both mirroring the source's idx_exam_sessions_exam_user and idx_exam_sessions_user_exam_status; idx_session_expires_status over (expires_at, status) stands in for the source's partial index idx_exam_sessions_expires_status WHERE status = 'in_progress' -- Letflow's index_def has no WHERE clause, so this becomes a full composite index rather than a partial one; the auto-submit sweep still uses it, just over a wider row set than the source scanned. OMISSIONS. No id, created_at or updated_at field is declared: the record subsystem owns record identity and the event store owns the timeline, so declaring them here would duplicate platform-owned state. No created_by field is declared for the same reason -- this table has no created_by column in the source anyway; user_id already plays that role and is handled above. CONSTRAINTS NOT EXPRESSIBLE HERE: the source's exam_sessions_score_range CHECK (score_pct BETWEEN 0 AND 100) and exam_sessions_expires_after_start CHECK (expires_at > started_at), both added by 015, are relocated to priv/packs/bilimbaga/entity_definitions/README-constraints.md with what is lost by relocating them. ON DELETE: exam_id's fk_def promotes to a Postgres FK that lib/letflow/entities/definition/ddl.ex:675 emits as ON DELETE RESTRICT unconditionally (decision 0025 sub-question 1), which diverges from the source's ON DELETE CASCADE on exam_sessions.exam_id -- see the ON DELETE table in README-constraints.md. user_id's source column is also ON DELETE CASCADE, but carries no Letflow fk_def at all (identity subsystem), so there is no Letflow FK for it to diverge from; it is still recorded in the README's table for completeness. EXAM SNAPSHOT (GH #2682 / REQ-511). exam_snapshot is :json, queried: false, required: false: the scoring-relevant exam content frozen when the session starts (answer key, question types, passing threshold, certificate facts), with a SHA-256 digest and a random nonce. Scoring and the autosave shape check read only this snapshot, never the live authoring rows. It carries the answer key, so it is restricted by field (entity_field_restrictions) and never appears in a candidate-facing response. TIMESTAMPTZ: started_at, expires_at, submitted_at (and the dropped created_at) were all TIMESTAMPTZ in the source; ddl.ex:318 maps :datetime to timestamp(6) without time zone, dropping the offset on all of them -- recorded in README-constraints.md, singling out expires_at because REQ-331's sweep compares it against now across tenants.
